input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship changepoint-detector (allocator row 2): item (2) NB1-like clumping
errors: Introduced a bug while wiring NB1 into poissonTrend (linAt subtracted sum x log e from the NB1 cost); found on development seeds (a bend kept on 8 of 8 straight ramps) and fixed before the pre-registered run.

First NB1 cost was ~100x slower than NB2 (three Newton iterations of Lanczos lgamma + digamma per point); a 600 s eval timed out. Replaced by one warm-started Newton step with a combined shift-and-series special-function pass: 2.5x NB2.

doc_friction.issue: The pkill -f bracket hook also rejects a command where the unbracketed path appears later on the same line (e.g. a following node eval/x.mjs); had to split into two calls. Worth one line in the cloud-session quirks.
5,264 lines; finding the context for a flagship item means grepping. The NB1 item pointed to one sentence at the end of the previous section, which was enough.

notes: Pre-registered six bars before any run (committed first, eval/nb1-preregistration.md). Pre-registered seeds 9701-9704, run once: all hold. NB1 ramps false changes per series nb 0.45/0.47 -> nb1 0.19/0.15; law check nb1 94/100 each (rest either), nb2 100/100 on NB2 ramps; step power 100 vs 100; phi 2.91/3.00 vs 3; Poisson read phi 1 on 97/100. On development seeds bar 1's 2-to-200 cell read 0.30 (>0.2); bars not moved. Full venture suite: 1 failure (page.test.mjs pinned the select markup), fixed; re-run 754/755 (update-rate-everywhere.test.mjs pinned the warning list), fixed; the touched test files then 39/39. CLI text now prints clumpingWarning. No separate docs/reports file: the pre-registration and README section carry what the next run needs.
